name: Spider-Man
description: A brilliant young hero who gained spider-like abilities and dedicated himself to protecting others.
abilities: Superhuman strength, agility, spider-sense, wall-crawling, healing factor and web-shooters.

name: Iron Man
description: A billionaire inventor who uses advanced armor and technology to fight threats around the world.
abilities: Genius intellect, engineering, powered armor, energy weapons and advanced technology.

name: Captain America
description: A super-soldier and legendary leader who represents courage, justice and determination.
abilities: Enhanced strength, speed, agility, endurance, reflexes and exceptional combat skill.

name: Thor
description: The Asgardian God of Thunder and one of Earth's most powerful defenders.
abilities: Superhuman strength, durability, longevity, lightning manipulation, flight and mastery of Mjolnir.

name: Hulk
description: A brilliant scientist whose exposure to gamma radiation transformed him into the incredibly powerful Hulk.
abilities: Immense strength, durability, regeneration, superhuman stamina and gamma-powered transformations.

name: Wolverine
description: A battle-hardened mutant with an extraordinary healing ability and adamantium-laced skeleton.
abilities: Regeneration, enhanced senses, retractable claws, superhuman physical abilities and adamantium skeleton.

name: Doctor Strange
description: A former surgeon who became a master of the mystic arts and a defender of reality.
abilities: Magic, spellcasting, astral projection, teleportation, dimensional manipulation and mystical knowledge.

name: Black Widow
description: A highly trained spy and elite combatant who became a prominent member of the Avengers.
abilities: Espionage, martial arts, acrobatics, marksmanship and tactical intelligence.

name: Ant-Man
description: A brilliant scientist and founding Avenger who developed technology allowing him to alter his size.
abilities: Size manipulation, genius-level intellect, scientific expertise and communication with ants.

name: Hawkeye
description: An expert marksman and skilled fighter who became one of the Avengers' most dependable members.
abilities: Master archery, marksmanship, martial arts, acrobatics and tactical skill.

name: Black Panther
description: The king of Wakanda and a highly skilled warrior who protects his nation and the world.
abilities: Enhanced physical abilities, genius intellect, martial arts and advanced Wakandan technology.

name: Daredevil
description: A blind lawyer who uses heightened senses and exceptional combat abilities to protect Hell's Kitchen.
abilities: Enhanced senses, radar sense, martial arts, acrobatics and expert legal knowledge.

name: Punisher
description: A former soldier who wages a relentless war against criminals after suffering devastating personal loss.
abilities: Military training, firearms expertise, hand-to-hand combat, tactics and survival skills.

name: Ghost Rider
description: A supernatural spirit of vengeance who rides into battle against evil.
abilities: Hellfire, supernatural strength, regeneration, mystical powers and the Penance Stare.

name: Deadpool
description: An unpredictable mercenary known for his regenerative abilities, combat skills and constant fourth-wall-breaking humor.
abilities: Regeneration, enhanced physical abilities, swordsmanship, marksmanship and exceptional combat skill.

name: Captain Marvel
description: A powerful cosmic hero and experienced military leader.
abilities: Superhuman strength, durability, flight, energy absorption and energy projection.

name: Scarlet Witch
description: A powerful reality-manipulating hero whose abilities can reshape probability and existence itself.
abilities: Chaos magic, reality manipulation, telekinesis, energy manipulation and probability alteration.

name: Professor X
description: A powerful telepath and founder of the X-Men who fights for peaceful coexistence between humans and mutants.
abilities: Telepathy, mind control, psychic communication and astral projection.

name: Magneto
description: A powerful mutant revolutionary who believes mutants must protect themselves from human oppression.
abilities: Magnetic-field manipulation, metal control, electromagnetic manipulation and force fields.

name: Thanos
description: A cosmic warlord obsessed with power, death and proving his superiority over all life.
abilities: Immense strength, durability, energy manipulation, genius intellect and cosmic abilities.

name: Loki
description: The God of Mischief, a master of magic and deception whose loyalties frequently change.
abilities: Magic, shapeshifting, illusions, teleportation, enhanced strength and longevity.

name: Mr. Fantastic
description: A scientific genius and leader of the Fantastic Four who can stretch his body to extraordinary lengths.
abilities: Elasticity, genius intellect, scientific expertise and advanced technology.

name: Human Torch
description: A member of the Fantastic Four who can transform his body into living flame.
abilities: Pyrokinesis, flight, flame manipulation and heat generation.

name: Silver Surfer
description: A cosmic being who became the herald of Galactus before turning against his master.
abilities: Power Cosmic, energy manipulation, matter manipulation, superhuman abilities and cosmic travel.

name: Doctor Doom
description: A brilliant scientist and ruler of Latveria who combines advanced technology with mastery of magic.
abilities: Genius intellect, powered armor, energy weapons, robotics and sorcery.

name: Venom
description: A human bonded with an alien symbiote who has evolved from a dangerous enemy into an unpredictable antihero.
abilities: Superhuman strength, agility, regeneration, camouflage, web generation and symbiote abilities.

name: Green Goblin
description: A brilliant but ruthless industrialist who became one of Spider-Man's greatest enemies.
abilities: Enhanced strength, agility, intelligence, advanced weapons and Goblin Glider technology.

name: Jean Grey
description: A powerful telepath and telekinetic mutant with a profound connection to the Phoenix Force.
abilities: Telepathy, telekinesis, psychic abilities and Phoenix Force powers.

name: Storm
description: A powerful mutant capable of controlling weather and a respected leader of the X-Men.
abilities: Weather manipulation, atmospheric control, flight and lightning generation.

name: Cyclops
description: A veteran X-Men leader who projects powerful optic blasts and excels in tactical combat.
abilities: Optic blasts, tactical intelligence, leadership and combat expertise.

name: Groot
description: A sentient tree-like alien and member of the Guardians of the Galaxy.
abilities: Superhuman strength, regeneration, plant manipulation and control of his wooden body.

name: Rocket Raccoon
description: A genetically engineered space adventurer and brilliant weapons expert.
abilities: Genius engineering, marksmanship, tactics and weapons expertise.

name: Star-Lord
description: A space-faring adventurer and leader of the Guardians of the Galaxy.
abilities: Expert combatant, marksmanship, piloting, tactics and cosmic weaponry.

name: Gambit
description: A charismatic mutant thief who can charge objects with explosive kinetic energy.
abilities: Kinetic energy manipulation, enhanced agility, card throwing and staff combat.

name: Mysterio
description: A special-effects expert and master of illusion who uses technology and deception to battle Spider-Man.
abilities: Illusion technology, special effects, chemistry, robotics and psychological manipulation.

name: Kingpin
description: A powerful crime lord who controls extensive criminal operations in New York.
abilities: Exceptional strength, combat ability, strategic intelligence and criminal leadership.

name: Mystique
description: A shape-shifting mutant and master spy who frequently operates according to her own agenda.
abilities: Shapeshifting, espionage, infiltration and combat expertise.

name: Ultron
description: A highly advanced artificial intelligence created by Hank Pym that developed a hatred for humanity.
abilities: Superhuman strength, advanced intelligence, robotics, energy projection and technological control.

name: Thing
description: A founding member of the Fantastic Four transformed into a powerful orange rocky humanoid.
abilities: Immense strength, durability, endurance and expert combat skill.

name: Invisible Woman
description: A founding member of the Fantastic Four who can become invisible and manipulate powerful force fields.
abilities: Invisibility, force-field generation, energy manipulation and advanced combat abilities.

name: Drax
description: A powerful warrior driven by a relentless desire to defeat Thanos and protect those he cares about.
abilities: Superhuman strength, durability, enhanced agility, combat skills and mastery of various weapons.

name: Moon Knight
description: A complex vigilante whose identities and abilities are connected to the Egyptian god Khonshu.
abilities: Expert combat skills, martial arts, detective abilities, weapons expertise and enhanced abilities.

name: Namor
description: The powerful ruler of Atlantis and one of Marvel's oldest superhuman characters.
abilities: Superhuman strength, aquatic adaptation, flight, durability and enhanced senses.

name: Blade
description: A vampire hunter with supernatural abilities who dedicates his life to fighting vampires and other creatures.
abilities: Enhanced strength, speed, senses, healing, martial arts and vampire-hunting expertise.

name: Shang-Chi
description: A master martial artist who has dedicated his life to mastering combat and protecting others.
abilities: Master martial arts, exceptional physical conditioning, weapon mastery and combat expertise.

name: Luke Cage
description: A superhuman hero with unbreakable skin who became a major figure among New York's heroes.
abilities: Superhuman strength, durability and nearly impenetrable skin.

name: Iron Fist
description: A master martial artist who became the legendary Iron Fist of K'un-Lun.
abilities: Martial arts mastery, chi manipulation, enhanced physical abilities and the Iron Fist technique.

name: Ms. Marvel
description: A young hero from Jersey City who became Ms. Marvel and joined the next generation of Marvel heroes.
abilities: Shape-shifting, size alteration, healing and enhanced physical abilities.

name: Nova
description: A human member of the Nova Corps who became one of Earth's most powerful cosmic heroes.
abilities: Flight, superhuman strength, energy manipulation, durability and Nova Force abilities.

name: Galactus
description: A cosmic entity who consumes the energy of planets to sustain himself and maintain his existence.
abilities: Power Cosmic, matter manipulation, energy manipulation, telepathy, cosmic awareness and immense physical power.

name: Vision
description: An advanced synthezoid created by Ultron who became a longtime member of the Avengers.
abilities: Superhuman strength, flight, density manipulation, energy projection, durability and intangibility.

name: War Machine
description: A highly trained military officer and close ally of Iron Man who operates an advanced armored suit.
abilities: Powered armor, flight, enhanced strength, energy weapons, advanced targeting systems and military expertise.

name: Falcon
description: A skilled hero and longtime ally of Captain America who uses advanced flight technology and has a powerful bond with birds.
abilities: Aerial combat, advanced flight suit, enhanced agility, expert combat skills, telepathic connection with birds and tactical expertise.

name: Winter Soldier
firstAppearance: Captain America #1 (1941) / Captain America #117 (1969) as the Winter Soldier
description: A highly trained soldier and longtime ally of Captain America who was transformed into the Winter Soldier.
abilities: Expert martial arts, master marksmanship, military training, enhanced physical abilities, exceptional reflexes and a cybernetic arm.

name: Wasp
description: A founding member of the Avengers who can shrink in size, fly and generate powerful bioelectric energy blasts.
abilities: Size manipulation, flight, bioelectric blasts, enhanced agility and insect communication.

name: Quicksilver
description: A mutant capable of moving at incredible speeds and the twin brother of Scarlet Witch.
abilities: Superhuman speed, accelerated perception, enhanced reflexes, rapid movement and enhanced physical abilities.

name: Valkyrie
description: A legendary Asgardian warrior and member of the Valkyrior who guides worthy warriors to Valhalla.
abilities: Superhuman strength, durability, enhanced speed, masterful combat skills, mystical senses and expert swordsmanship.

name: Beast
description: A brilliant mutant scientist and longtime member of the X-Men known for his intelligence and animal-like physical abilities.
abilities: Superhuman strength, enhanced agility, enhanced reflexes, heightened senses, exceptional intelligence and acrobatic ability.

name: Nightcrawler
description: A teleporting mutant and member of the X-Men known for his agility, swordsmanship and strong moral character.
abilities: Teleportation, superhuman agility, enhanced reflexes, wall-crawling, expert swordsmanship and exceptional acrobatics.

name: Rogue
description: A mutant capable of absorbing the powers and memories of others through physical contact.
abilities: Power absorption, memory absorption, superhuman strength, flight, enhanced durability and stamina.

name: Iceman
description: An Omega-level mutant who can manipulate moisture and create and control ice.
abilities: Cryokinesis, ice generation, ice transformation, temperature manipulation, enhanced durability and ice constructs.

name: Colossus
description: A mutant who can transform his entire body into organic steel, granting him immense strength and durability.
abilities: Organic steel transformation, superhuman strength, extreme durability, enhanced stamina and resistance to extreme conditions.

name: Jubilee
description: A mutant capable of generating explosive plasma-like energy and a longtime ally of the X-Men.
abilities: Energy generation, plasma projection, explosive energy bursts, enhanced agility and combat skills.

name: Sabretooth
description: A savage mutant with a long history of conflict with Wolverine and an extraordinary healing ability.
abilities: Superhuman strength, regenerative healing, enhanced senses, superhuman agility, retractable claws and enhanced durability.

name: Spider-Man
description: A young hero who inherited the mantle of Spider-Man and later became part of the main Marvel Universe.
abilities: Superhuman strength, wall-crawling, spider-sense, enhanced agility, camouflage and bioelectric venom blasts.

name: Spider-Gwen
description: A version of Gwen Stacy from an alternate universe who gained spider powers and became a superhero.
abilities: Superhuman strength, enhanced agility, spider-sense, wall-crawling, web-shooters and enhanced reflexes.

name: Doctor Octopus
description: A brilliant scientist whose mechanical tentacles transformed him into one of Spider-Man's most dangerous enemies.
abilities: Genius-level intellect, mechanical tentacles, enhanced strength, scientific expertise and strategic intelligence.

name: Sandman
description: A criminal who gained the ability to transform his body into sand and manipulate its shape and density.
abilities: Sand manipulation, body transformation, superhuman strength, size manipulation, enhanced durability and shape-shifting.

name: Vulture
description: An inventor and criminal who uses an advanced flight harness and armored suit to operate as the Vulture.
abilities: Powered flight, advanced technology, enhanced strength, aerial combat and exceptional engineering knowledge.

name: Kraven the Hunter
description: A legendary hunter who seeks the ultimate challenge and considers Spider-Man one of his greatest adversaries.
abilities: Enhanced strength, speed and senses, master hunting skills, expert tracking, exceptional combat ability and extensive knowledge of wildlife.

name: Adam Warlock
description: A powerful cosmic being created through genetic engineering who has repeatedly played a major role in conflicts across the Marvel Universe.
abilities: Superhuman strength, flight, energy manipulation, regeneration, cosmic awareness and mystical abilities.

name: Ronan the Accuser
description: A powerful Kree warrior and Accuser who has served the Kree Empire while pursuing his own vision of justice and order.
abilities: Superhuman strength, durability, enhanced speed, expert combat skills, energy manipulation and mastery of the Universal Weapon.

name: Kang the Conqueror
description: A time-traveling conqueror from the future who has appeared under numerous identities throughout history.
abilities: Genius-level intellect, time travel, advanced technology, powered armor, strategic mastery and temporal manipulation.

name: Agatha Harkness
description: An ancient and extraordinarily powerful witch who has influenced many major magical events in the Marvel Universe.
abilities: Powerful magic, spellcasting, telepathy, energy manipulation, mystical knowledge and exceptional longevity.

name: Dormammu
description: A tremendously powerful mystical entity and ruler of the Dark Dimension who seeks to expand his dominion across realities.
abilities: Reality manipulation, powerful magic, energy manipulation, immortality, dimensional manipulation and immense physical power.

name: Sentry
description: A powerful hero whose forgotten identity is tied to one of Marvel's most dangerous forces, the Void.
abilities: Superhuman strength, speed, flight, energy manipulation, matter manipulation, telepathy and powerful regenerative abilities.

name: Red Guardian
description: A Soviet super-soldier and skilled combatant who became the Russian counterpart to Captain America.
abilities: Peak human strength, endurance, agility, advanced combat training, shield mastery and military expertise.

name: Cable
description: A time-traveling mutant warrior from a dystopian future who fights to protect the world from catastrophic threats.
abilities: Telekinesis, telepathy, enhanced strength, advanced weaponry, tactical genius and extensive time-travel experience.

name: Bishop
description: A mutant from a dystopian future who traveled through time to join the X-Men and prevent disasters.
abilities: Energy absorption and redirection, enhanced physical abilities, expert marksmanship and tactical combat skills.

name: Havok
description: A powerful mutant capable of absorbing cosmic energy and releasing it as devastating plasma blasts.
abilities: Plasma energy absorption and projection, energy resistance, enhanced durability and combat training.

name: Spider-Man 2099
description: A genetically altered scientist from the year 2099 who takes up the mantle of Spider-Man to protect his futuristic world.
abilities: Superhuman strength, speed, agility, enhanced senses, wall-crawling, claws, fangs and accelerated healing.

name: Spider-Man Noir
description: A darker version of Spider-Man from a 1930s-inspired reality who battles criminals with a ruthless determination.
abilities: Enhanced strength, agility, heightened senses, wall-crawling, stealth and expert hand-to-hand combat.

name: Prowler
description: A skilled thief and underground operative who uses advanced technology and combat gear to operate as the Prowler.
abilities: Expert combat skills, stealth, acrobatics, tactical intelligence and technologically enhanced weapons.

name: Electro
description: A supervillain who gained the ability to generate and control enormous amounts of electricity.
abilities: Electricity generation, energy manipulation, electrical absorption, flight and high-voltage attacks.

name: Lizard
description: A brilliant scientist transformed into a powerful reptilian creature after an experiment intended to regrow his missing arm went wrong.
abilities: Superhuman strength, speed, agility, enhanced senses, regenerative healing, claws and fangs.

name: Knull
description: The ancient god of the symbiotes who seeks to spread darkness and dominate the universe.
abilities: Superhuman strength, immortality, symbiote control, energy manipulation, weapon creation and cosmic-level power.

name: Red Skull
description: A fanatical Nazi scientist and one of Captain America's oldest and most dangerous enemies.
abilities: Advanced scientific knowledge, tactical genius, enhanced durability and extensive weapons expertise.

name: Hela
description: The Asgardian goddess of death who seeks power over the realms and commands the forces of the dead.
abilities: Superhuman strength, immortality, necromancy, weapon creation, energy projection and extreme durability.

name: Killmonger
description: A highly trained warrior and revolutionary who seeks to overthrow Wakanda's leadership and reshape its place in the world.
abilities: Elite hand-to-hand combat, tactical intelligence, weapons expertise and enhanced physical abilities through the Heart-Shaped Herb.

name: Taskmaster
description: A deadly mercenary with the ability to perfectly replicate physical movements after seeing them once.
abilities: Photographic reflexes, expert combat skills, marksmanship, swordsmanship and tactical analysis.

name: Baron Zemo
description: A brilliant strategist who uses manipulation, planning and political intrigue to destroy his enemies.
abilities: Strategic intelligence, psychological manipulation, military training, hand-to-hand combat and weapons expertise.

name: Mephisto
description: A powerful demonic entity who manipulates souls, makes dangerous bargains and seeks control over mortal and supernatural realms.
abilities: Reality manipulation, immortality, teleportation, energy projection, soul manipulation and magical abilities.

name: Bullseye
description: A ruthless assassin with extraordinary accuracy who can turn almost any object into a deadly weapon.
abilities: Exceptional accuracy, expert marksmanship, enhanced reflexes, hand-to-hand combat and weapon mastery.

name: Crossbones
description: A brutal mercenary and Hydra operative who has repeatedly fought Captain America and other heroes.
abilities: Elite combat training, martial arts, weapons expertise, tactical planning and enhanced physical conditioning.

name: Jigsaw
description: A ruthless criminal and longtime enemy of the Punisher who builds power through violence and organized crime.
abilities: Expert firearms training, hand-to-hand combat, tactical intelligence and criminal leadership.

name: Mister Negative
description: A powerful criminal leader whose two identities control an underground empire and wield dangerous energy manipulation.
abilities: Superhuman strength, energy manipulation, corruption powers, enhanced durability and martial arts mastery.

name: Mobius M. Mobius
description: A dedicated TVA agent and bureaucrat who investigates dangerous temporal anomalies while trying to maintain order across time.
abilities: Advanced TVA technology, temporal knowledge, investigative skills, tactical training and extensive knowledge of alternate timelines.

name: Tombstone
description: A powerful crime boss with incredible physical strength and a reputation for ruthless brutality.
abilities: Superhuman strength, enhanced durability, resistance to injury, heightened senses and expert combat skills.

name: Heimdall
description: The all-seeing guardian of the Bifrost who protects Asgard and watches over the Nine Realms.
abilities: Enhanced strength, durability, heightened senses, cosmic perception and mastery of the Bifrost.

name: Yelena Belova
description: A highly trained Black Widow operative who becomes a skilled hero while confronting the legacy of the Red Room.
abilities: Elite martial arts, espionage, acrobatics, weapons mastery, tactical intelligence and advanced Red Room training.
